summary: A restrained, actor-led act ending. The repeated «رِجَّالَةْ» risks sentimentality on paper, but Shalabi’s exhausted whisper and the silent burial action make it credible and specific to the moment.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: Speak down toward the grave, not out to the men. Let the pause carry the loss; the second phrase should come on a failing breath, without sobbing or declamation.

lines.text: اللَّهْ يِرْحَمْكُمْ يَا رِجَّالَةْ… كُنْتُوا رِجَّالَةْ.
